title: Learning the Dose Manifold: A Latent Diffusion Framework for Volumetric Dose Prediction in Automated Radiotherapy Treatment Planning
title_zh: 学习剂量流形：用于自动放射治疗计划中容积剂量预测的潜在扩散框架

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出潜在扩散框架LaDose，实现全自动放疗计划中的全容积剂量预测，误差中位数仅1.18 Gy并显著提升计划生成效率。 Automated treatment planning (ATP) aims to reduce the unwarranted inter-planner variability of manual planning, while improving treatment quality and efficiency. Most ATP pipelines rely on the prediction of the achievable three-dimensional dose distribution for a given anatomy and the subsequent optimization of machine parameters to reproduce it. Diffusion-based methods are largely slice-wise due to the high dimensionality of radiotherapy data, and assume a one-to-one mapping between anatomy and optimal dose despite the multi-objective nature of treatment planning. They are evaluated on their ability to match reference doses and rarely on their integration in ATP frameworks. We present LaDose, a latent diffusion framework for fully volumetric dose prediction. An autoencoder learned on dose distributions, trained so that perturbed latents decode to plausible doses, compresses dose maps 128-fold and enables 3D diffusion on a single GPU. Prescription values are represented as exact scalar vectors that bypass the image encoder, avoiding resampling and latent compression. Multiscale classifier-free guidance allows for the modulation of clinical trade-offs at inference, without retraining or additional labeled data. On 900 clinically delivered head-and-neck volumetric modulated arc therapy plans from five centers, LaDose reached a median absolute error of 1.18 Gy (1.4--1.8\% of the prescription) and was the only one of six frameworks free of systematic bias with respect to the reference distribution. Guidance scales acted predictably on target coverage and organ-at-risk sparing. Integrated with direct aperture optimization, the pipeline generated plans in 15.2 minutes; in a blinded review, senior clinicians rated 14 of 15 plans acceptable without editing.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出潜在扩散框架LaDose，实现全自动放疗计划中的全容积剂量预测，误差中位数仅1.18 Gy并显著提升计划生成效率。 自动化治疗计划（ATP）旨在减少人工计划中不必要的计划者间差异，同时提升治疗质量与效率。 大多数ATP流程依赖于预测给定解剖结构可达到的三维剂量分布，随后优化机器参数以复现该分布。 由于放疗数据的高维性，基于扩散的方法大多按逐层方式进行，并且尽管治疗计划具有多目标特性，仍假设解剖结构与最优剂量之间存在一一映射。 这些方法通常以匹配参考剂量的能力进行评估，而很少评估其在ATP框架中的集成效果。 我们提出LaDose，一个用于全容积剂量预测的潜在扩散框架。 一个在剂量分布上训练的自编码器（其训练方式使受扰动的潜在表示解码为合理剂量）将剂量图压缩128倍，从而支持在单块GPU上进行3D扩散。 处方值以精确的标量向量表示，绕过图像编码器，避免了重采样和潜在压缩。 多尺度无分类器引导允许在推理时调节临床权衡，无需重新训练或额外的标注数据。 在来自五个中心的900个临床交付的头颈部容积调强弧形治疗计划上，LaDose达到了1.18 Gy的中位绝对误差（处方的1.4--1.8\%），并且是六个框架中唯一相对于参考分布不存在系统偏差的框架。 引导强度对靶区覆盖和危及器官保护产生了可预期的作用。 与直接孔径优化集成后，该流程在15.2分钟内生成计划；在一项盲法评审中，资深临床医师认为15个计划中有14个无需编辑即可接受。
